metadata.description: Comprehensive database of places in Alexandria for personality-based tourism recommendation. Each place includes rich descriptions and personality-relevant attributes to help an LLM match places to OCEAN personality scores.

places.name: Bibliotheca Alexandrina
places.description: A stunning modern library and cultural complex built in 2002 as a revival of the ancient Library of Alexandria. It houses over 8 million books, 4 museums, 4 art galleries, a planetarium, and 12 research centers. Perfect for intellectually curious, reflective visitors who enjoy exploring ideas, art, science and history in a calm and inspiring space.
places.ideal_for: reading, learning, art appreciation, self-reflection

places.name: Citadel of Qaitbay (Fort Qaitbey)
places.description: A magnificent 15th-century sea fortress built by Sultan Qaitbey on the site of the ancient Pharos Lighthouse, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Features sweeping Mediterranean views, a small maritime museum, and ancient stone pillars. Ideal for history lovers and adventurous explorers who enjoy iconic landmarks with dramatic scenery.
places.ideal_for: history exploration, photography, sightseeing
places.best_time: morning or late afternoon for golden light

places.name: Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
places.description: One of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages — an eerie and fascinating underground burial complex carved into bedrock in the 2nd century AD. Descends three stories deep with a unique fusion of Egyptian, Greek and Roman art and architecture. Perfect for curious, open-minded visitors who love exploring the unusual and the macabre.
places.ideal_for: history enthusiasts, adventurers, curious minds

places.name: Alexandria National Museum
places.description: Housed in a beautifully restored Italianate villa, this thoughtfully curated museum traces Alexandria's full history from antiquity to the modern era. Features artifacts from the Greco-Roman period, underwater discoveries from the Mediterranean, and Coptic and Islamic art. Great for reflective visitors who prefer a quieter, more intimate museum experience.
places.ideal_for: history lovers, museum-goers, quiet exploration

places.name: Pompey's Pillar & Serapeum Ruins
places.description: A towering 27-meter red granite column from 297 AD, the tallest surviving ancient monolithic column outside Rome. Sits amid the ruins of the grand Serapeum temple complex with sphinx statues and ancient tunnels. A striking open-air historical site that rewards those who appreciate grandeur and solitude.
places.ideal_for: history buffs, photography, reflective walks

places.name: Roman Amphitheatre at Kom El Dikka
places.description: The only known Roman amphitheater in Egypt, built in the 2nd century AD with 13 semicircular marble tiers that once seated 800 citizens. Used for music, poetry, and public events. Located at the Kom Al Dikka archaeological site which also includes ancient Roman baths and villas. A unique and serene historical experience.
places.ideal_for: archaeology enthusiasts, history lovers, photographers

places.name: Royal Jewelry Museum
places.description: Housed in a stunning former royal palace built in 1919, this museum displays over 11,000 pieces of jewelry and royal treasures from Egypt's Muhammad Ali dynasty. The building itself is an architectural gem with ornate ceilings, carved walls, and stained glass. Best for visitors who appreciate beauty, luxury, and the finer details of art and history.
places.ideal_for: art lovers, design enthusiasts, history buffs
places.location: 27 Ahmed Yehia Pasha Street, Zizinia, Alexandria

places.name: Montazah Palace Gardens
places.description: Alexandria's most beautiful green space — sprawling seaside royal gardens surrounding the 19th-century Montazah Palace of King Farouk. Features manicured flower beds, palm-lined avenues, an ornate pink bridge, sea views, and private beaches. Perfect for relaxed family outings, romantic walks, or anyone seeking peace and natural beauty by the Mediterranean.
places.ideal_for: nature lovers, picnics, leisurely walks, photography

places.name: Abu Abbas Al-Mursi Mosque
places.description: One of Alexandria's most iconic and beautiful mosques, built in Andalusian Islamic architectural style with intricate geometric designs and soaring minarets. Located in the Anfushi neighborhood near the Eastern Harbour. A spiritual and architectural landmark that reflects Alexandria's deep cultural and religious heritage.
places.ideal_for: culture seekers, spiritual visitors, architecture lovers

places.name: Anfushi District & Eastern Harbour Walk
places.description: An authentic, off-the-beaten-path neighborhood near the Eastern Harbour representing old Alexandria away from tourist crowds. Narrow streets, traditional fishermen's life, old Ottoman-era houses, and a raw glimpse into everyday Alexandrian coastal life. Ideal for curious, adventurous visitors who prefer authentic local experiences over polished tourist spots.
places.ideal_for: urban explorers, photographers, culture seekers

places.name: Stanley Bridge & Corniche Walk
places.description: Stanley Bridge is one of Alexandria's most photographed modern landmarks on the Corniche, offering panoramic Mediterranean views especially during sunset. The 3km Corniche promenade stretches along the harbor dotted with restaurants, markets, and historic sights. Great for social, active visitors who enjoy walking, people-watching, and soaking up the city's energy.
places.ideal_for: walking, photography, sunsets, socializing

places.name: Al-Horreya Road (Fouad Street)
places.description: Alexandria's most historic boulevard, known locally as Fouad Street, showcasing the city's Belle Epoque architecture from the late 19th and early 20th century. A melting pot of Egyptian, Italian, Greek, French, and Armenian heritage in its buildings, shops, and cafes. A must for those who love wandering, history, and discovering the layers of a city's past.
places.atmosphere: nostalgic, walkable, culturally layered, slightly chaotic
places.ideal_for: architecture lovers, history explorers, flâneurs

places.name: Stanley Beach
places.description: One of Alexandria's most popular and lively beaches near the iconic Stanley Bridge. A vibrant social hub especially in summer, with crowds, music, food stalls, and a buzzing waterfront energy. Best for outgoing, energetic visitors who love being surrounded by people and a festive beach atmosphere.
places.ideal_for: socializing, swimming, people-watching

places.name: Mamoura Beach
places.description: A cleaner, less crowded beach on the eastern edge of Alexandria near Montazah. Known for its calmer atmosphere compared to central Alexandria beaches. Great for visitors who want to enjoy the Mediterranean Sea without the overwhelming crowds and noise of busier beaches.
places.ideal_for: swimming, relaxing, peaceful coastal experience

places.name: Agami Beach
places.description: A popular beach resort area west of Alexandria, known for its cleaner waters and summer vacation atmosphere. Features private beach clubs, water sports, cafes, and a lively summer scene. Loved by Alexandrian families and young groups looking for a more resort-like beach experience.
places.ideal_for: water sports, beach parties, family fun

places.name: Scuba Diving & Underwater Archaeology
places.description: Alexandria's underwater world is one of the most unique in the Mediterranean — sunken ruins of Cleopatra's palace, ancient statues, and Greco-Roman artifacts lying on the seafloor just 10 meters deep in the Eastern Harbour. Several dive operators offer guided dives for certified divers. An extraordinary, bucket-list experience for adventurous, open-minded visitors.
places.ideal_for: adventurers, divers, history lovers, thrill-seekers

places.name: Antoniades Gardens
places.description: A peaceful and somewhat hidden botanical garden in the Smouha district, featuring rare plants, sculptures, fountains, and manicured pathways. Originally a private estate, now open to the public. A tranquil escape from the city's hustle, ideal for nature lovers and introverted visitors who prefer quiet, green spaces.
places.ideal_for: nature lovers, quiet walks, reading, escaping the city

places.name: Greek Club (White & Blue Restaurant)
places.description: Arguably Alexandria's most iconic restaurant, perched above the Eastern Harbour with an unbeatable panoramic sea view. A white-and-blue interior evokes the Greek island aesthetic. Serves fresh seafood and select Greek dishes. A classic, somewhat upscale experience loved by locals and visitors alike. Best for those who value ambiance, quality, and a special meal.
places.crowd_level: moderate to high (book ahead on weekends)
places.ideal_for: romantic dinner, celebrating, seafood lovers, atmosphere seekers
places.best_time: lunch or dinner with sunset view

places.name: Mohamed Ahmed Restaurant
places.description: A legendary local institution open since 1957, serving Alexandria's most famous fuul (fava beans) and falafel breakfast for over 60 years. International royalty and celebrities have dined here alongside everyday Alexandrians. Famous for its roasted eggplant, tahini, baba ganoush, pickles, and freshly baked feteer bread. An authentic must-visit for food explorers.
places.ideal_for: local food lovers, budget dining, authentic experience
places.location: Shokour Street, Al Attarin, Downtown Alexandria

places.name: Kadoura Restaurant
places.description: A well-established seafood institution on the Corniche since 1950. You pick your fresh fish downstairs, get a numbered token, and enjoy it grilled upstairs with included salads and tahini. Very popular for Friday family lunches. Fresh, straightforward, and reliably delicious. Great for social groups and families who want no-nonsense fresh seafood.
places.ideal_for: family dining, fresh seafood, local experience

places.name: Balbaa Village for Grills & Seafood
places.description: A beloved local two-storey restaurant in Sidi Gaber, famous for generous portions of grilled meats and fresh seafood. You select your fish directly from the day's catch. Open late into the night. A lively, social dining spot popular with Alexandrian families and friend groups. Great for extroverted visitors who want a local, energetic atmosphere.
places.atmosphere: lively, social, generous, local, open late
places.ideal_for: group dining, mixed grill lovers, late-night eating

places.name: Seaside Restaurant
places.description: A modern, stylish seafood restaurant near the Greek Club offering a creative take on Mediterranean seafood. Known for its signature black pasta with shrimp (squid ink), stuffed calamari, and fresh catch prepared with contemporary techniques. Instagram-worthy, popular with young Alexandrians on dates. Great for open, curious diners who want something beyond traditional preparations.
places.ideal_for: foodies, date night, creative cuisine, young crowd
places.location: Eastern Harbour Peninsula area, Bahary, Alexandria

places.name: Byblos Restaurant (Four Seasons San Stefano)
places.description: The signature restaurant of the Four Seasons Hotel at San Stefano, offering refined Lebanese and Syrian cuisine with panoramic Mediterranean views. Serves exquisite mezze, sheikh al manshee, kebbeh bel laban, and an excellent prix-fixe menu. Formal, elegant, and perfect for a special occasion or a visitor who appreciates luxury dining.
places.atmosphere: formal, luxurious, refined, romantic, panoramic views
places.ideal_for: special occasions, luxury dining, romantic evening
places.location: Four Seasons Hotel, San Stefano, Alexandria

places.name: Zephyrion Restaurant (Abu Qir)
places.description: A hidden gem in the Abu Qir fishing village east of Alexandria, beloved by locals who make a special trip for its exceptionally fresh seafood. The restaurant has an almost Greek island feel — simple setting by the sea, fish that comes straight off the boats. The best place for absolute seafood freshness in all of Alexandria.
places.crowd_level: low (locals only, off the tourist trail)
places.ideal_for: adventurous food lovers, absolute freshness seekers, hidden gems

places.name: Teatro Restaurant & Art Space
places.description: A unique combination of restaurant, cultural center, and art space located in a historic Italian-built building from 1928. Serves classic Egyptian favorites — breakfast, feteer, tajines, casseroles — while hosting art exhibitions, live performances, film screenings, and children's activities. Run by a group of artists. Perfect for creative, culturally open visitors.
places.activity_type: solo, couple, or small creative group
places.ideal_for: artists, culture lovers, creative minds, unique dining

places.name: Arous El-Bahr (Bride of the Sea)
places.description: A small, family-run seafood shack on the beach in the El Max area on the western outskirts of Alexandria. Fishermen bring in their catch and it gets cooked right there while you sit looking out at the Mediterranean with a lighthouse in the background. No menu, no rush — pure, simple Alexandrian seafood at its most authentic.
places.ideal_for: off the beaten path lovers, authentic food, peaceful dining

places.name: Ebn El Balad / Ebn Hamido Waterfront
places.description: A dual-concept waterfront restaurant near Gleem Bay — go right for mixed grills (stuffed pigeon, vegetable tagine) or left for fresh seafood (grilled sea bass). Maritime-meets-traditional Egyptian decor. One of the best spots for fresh food on the Mediterranean. Great for groups where people want different things.
places.ideal_for: mixed groups, grills & seafood, waterfront dining

places.name: Trianon Café
places.description: One of Alexandria's oldest and most magnificent cafes, operating since 1905 inside Le Metropole Hotel on the Corniche. Retains its original Art Nouveau decor — ornate wooden chandeliers, swirling murals, high ceilings. Famous patrons included Umm Kulthum and Naguib Mahfouz. Known for its Om Ali dessert and old-world elegance. A nostalgic journey to colonial-era Alexandria.
places.ideal_for: history lovers, aesthetes, people who appreciate vintage atmosphere
places.location: 52 Saad Zaghloul Square, Raml Station, Alexandria

places.name: Délices Patisserie
places.description: A Greek-Egyptian patisserie institution over 100 years old, run by the same family since 1922. Famous for its Cassata ice cream, Greek baklava drizzled with honey and cinnamon, cheesecakes, red velvet cake, and freshly baked club sandwiches. A calm, elegant spot with a touch of Alexandria's cosmopolitan golden era. Great for those who appreciate tradition and good pastries.
places.ideal_for: pastry lovers, nostalgia seekers, casual coffee breaks

places.name: Café de la Paix
places.description: One of Alexandria's oldest cafes, open since the late 19th century. Frequented by E.M. Forster, Lawrence Durrell, Winston Churchill, and King Farouk. Survived two World Wars while retaining its 19th-century charm. A living piece of Alexandrian literary and political history. Perfect for intellectuals, writers, and those who love historic spaces steeped in story.
places.ideal_for: intellectuals, writers, history lovers, solo reflection

places.name: Brazilian Coffee Store
places.description: A historic coffee store from an earlier era, one of the few remaining cafes capturing the spirit of cosmopolitan Alexandria. The walls are painted with vintage Brazilian maps and a giant Brazilian flag on the ceiling. Known for quality coffee at reasonable prices, delicious pastries, and a lively local atmosphere. A quirky, authentic local gem.
places.crowd_level: moderate to high (tends to be crowded and smoky)
places.ideal_for: local culture, good coffee, quirky atmosphere, budget-friendly

places.name: Carlos Cafe
places.description: A popular modern cafe on the Corniche with direct Mediterranean sea views. One of the first established coffee shops of its kind in the city. Serves salads, sandwiches, pasta, pastries, and good coffee in a relaxed beachside atmosphere. Comfortable, accessible, and great for watching the sunset. Ideal for social groups or casual outings.
places.ideal_for: casual hangout, coffee with a view, sunset watching
places.location: Corniche, Mustafa Kamel, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria

places.name: Cilantro Café
places.description: A popular western-style cafe chain with multiple branches in Alexandria, including one near Bibliotheca Alexandrina with sea views. Known for reliable good coffee, lattes, mochas, wraps, sandwiches, and pastries. Clean, comfortable, and familiar. Great for visitors who want a reliable, calm work or rest spot, or those who prefer familiar international cafe culture.
places.ideal_for: remote work, casual meetings, reliable coffee, calmer atmosphere
places.location: Multiple branches including Bibliotheca Alexandrina area

places.name: Gleem Bay Food Avenue
places.description: A modern two-story food court in San Stefano/Gleem area with chic cafes, seafood joints, burger spots, and international food brands. Offers awe-inspiring views of the coast and high-rise buildings. Very popular with young Alexandrians. Great for social, extroverted visitors who want variety, good views, and a vibrant, modern crowd.
places.atmosphere: modern, vibrant, social, youthful, coastal views
places.ideal_for: social hangouts, food variety, coastal views, young crowd

places.name: Tivoli Dome Alexandria
places.description: A popular dining and entertainment complex in Sidi Gaber with a wide variety of restaurants, cafes, and social spaces. Known for its vibrant atmosphere, stylish architecture, and regular events. A lively hub for Alexandrians looking to socialize, dine, and be entertained all in one place.
places.ideal_for: social outings, trying different cuisines, entertainment
places.location: Tivoli Dome Mall, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria

places.name: Gold's Gym Smouha
places.description: The Alexandria branch of the world-famous Gold's Gym in the Smouha district. World-class equipment, certified personal trainers, group fitness classes, and professional bodybuilding programs. A serious, motivating gym environment popular with fitness-focused Alexandrians. Best for disciplined, goal-oriented visitors who prioritize their workout routine even while traveling.
places.atmosphere: professional, energetic, motivating, serious fitness culture
places.ideal_for: bodybuilders, serious fitness enthusiasts, structured workouts

places.name: Powerhouse Gym Alexandria
places.description: A strength-focused fitness facility in the Stanley area with a dedicated CrossFit box, heavy free weights, and functional training equipment. Popular with serious athletes and the CrossFit community in Alexandria. Features group WOD sessions and individual training. Great for competitive, disciplined fitness enthusiasts who want an intense, community-driven workout.
places.ideal_for: CrossFit enthusiasts, athletes, high-intensity training

places.name: Titanium Fitness Club
places.description: A high-end boutique fitness club in Roushdy offering a diverse range of classes including Zumba, Pilates, Spin, and yoga alongside standard gym equipment. Focuses on wellness as much as fitness. Popular with women and those seeking a more balanced, holistic fitness experience. Great for visitors who prefer a social, class-based workout environment.
places.ideal_for: yoga & Pilates lovers, Zumba fans, wellness seekers, women

places.name: Four Seasons Fitness Centre (San Stefano)
places.description: A state-of-the-art 24-hour fitness center spanning three separate facilities at the Four Seasons San Stefano Hotel, including a squash court and an exclusive Ladies Gym. Features 400-exercise circuit training system, certified personal trainers, group studio classes (limited to 3-5 people), and sea views. The most luxurious workout environment in Alexandria.
places.ideal_for: luxury seekers, serious training in premium environment, privacy
places.location: Four Seasons Hotel, San Stefano, Alexandria

places.name: Unlimited Gym (Camp Chezar)
places.description: A well-reviewed local gym in the Camp Chezar area offering full gym services including weights, cardio equipment, and personal training. Known as one of the best gyms in Alexandria for its friendly environment, clean facilities, high-quality equipment, and affordable pricing. Great for budget-conscious visitors who want a serious workout without premium prices.
places.ideal_for: budget-conscious fitness fans, locals experience, daily workouts
places.location: 11 Kafr Saqr Street, Camp Chezar, Alexandria

places.name: Ladies Fitness Club Roushdy
places.description: A popular women-only fitness center in the Roushdy district offering a private, comfortable environment for female visitors and residents. Features female trainers, specialized fitness programs, Zumba, yoga, and standard equipment. Monthly memberships available. Great for women who prefer privacy and an all-female supportive fitness environment.
places.ideal_for: women seeking privacy, yoga & dance classes, supportive community

places.name: Beachfront Running Track (Corniche)
places.description: The Alexandria Corniche offers one of Egypt's best outdoor running experiences — a long, scenic promenade along the Mediterranean with sea breezes, stunning views, and a vibrant atmosphere. Popular with local runners, cyclists, and walkers, especially in the early morning. Free, accessible, and perfect for active visitors who enjoy exercising outdoors.
places.ideal_for: runners, cyclists, outdoor fitness enthusiasts

places.name: City Centre Alexandria
places.description: Alexandria's biggest shopping mall with over 169 stores, hosting major international brands like H&M, Zara, Nike, and Adidas alongside a massive Carrefour hypermarket, a 7-screen cinema complex, Magic Planet entertainment zone for kids, and a wide food court. A one-stop destination for families and shoppers who want variety, entertainment, and international brands under one roof.
places.ideal_for: family outings, international shopping, cinema, kids entertainment
places.location: Cairo Alex Desert Rd, Moharam Bek, Alexandria

places.name: San Stefano Grand Plaza Mall
places.description: Alexandria's most upscale mall located in the prestigious San Stefano area, part of a luxury complex including the Four Seasons Hotel and a private marina. Features 4 floors of high-end boutiques and international luxury brands, a 10-screen cinema, an amusement center for kids, coffee shops, and a food court with Mediterranean sea views. Perfect for visitors who enjoy premium shopping in an elegant setting.
places.activity_type: couple, family, or solo luxury shopping
places.ideal_for: luxury shopping, upscale brands, cinema, sea view dining
places.location: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria

places.name: Green Plaza Mall
places.description: A massive sprawling complex with over 370 shops making it one of Egypt's largest malls by store count. Features an open-air shopping street concept, a full theme park called Fun Planet, cinema, ice skating rink, and every major Egyptian and international retail brand. Very popular with Alexandrian families for its all-day entertainment options alongside shopping.
places.atmosphere: vast, family-oriented, entertaining, open-air sections, casual
places.ideal_for: family day out, kids entertainment, budget to mid-range shopping, theme park
places.location: 14th of May Bridge Rd, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria

places.name: Orouba Mall
places.description: A modern, well-designed neighborhood mall with a focus on fashion and lifestyle. Features a large supermarket on the ground floor, trendy clothing boutiques, accessories, jewelry stores with souvenir sections, stylish cafes, and a small kids play area. More manageable in size than the mega-malls, creating a more relaxed, less overwhelming shopping experience.
places.atmosphere: modern, relaxed, neighborhood feel, trendy, manageable
places.ideal_for: casual shopping, fashion, lifestyle browsing, manageable size

places.name: Designia Mall
places.description: A hidden gem mall for design lovers and creative minds. Goes beyond retail by housing unique boutiques, art galleries, creative spaces, and premium brands like Azza Fahmy jewelry. Features a gourmet food market and upscale dining options. A more intimate, curated alternative to the mega-malls for visitors who appreciate art, design, and quality over quantity.
places.atmosphere: artistic, boutique, curated, creative, intimate, upscale
places.ideal_for: design enthusiasts, art lovers, premium brands, unique gifts

places.name: Souq El-Attarine (Antique Market)
places.description: Alexandria's most famous and fascinating traditional market — a labyrinth of narrow pedestrian streets packed with antique dealers, rare Egyptian artifacts, vintage furniture, traditional clothing, jewelry, fragrances, French-inspired antiques, spices, belly-dancing costumes, papyrus, and hookah accessories. One of the most authentic and atmospheric places in all of Alexandria. A paradise for curious explorers and collectors.
places.atmosphere: chaotic, atmospheric, authentic, historic, sensory overload
places.ideal_for: antique hunters, curious explorers, souvenir shopping, photography

places.name: Zanit Al-Sitat (Women's Bazaar)
places.description: Known as Alexandria's busiest and most colorful women's market — a cramped, vibrant alleyway packed with women's clothing, cosmetics, accessories, wallets, belts, beads, gadgets, candle-making supplies, and craft materials at very affordable prices. A truly local, unpolished, and fascinating experience that feels completely off the tourist radar.
places.atmosphere: local, vibrant, cramped, lively, authentic, chaotic
places.ideal_for: bargain hunters, local culture lovers, accessories, crafts supplies

places.name: Halaket Al-Asmaak (Fish Market Anfushi)
places.description: Alexandria's legendary fish market in the Anfushi fishing district — a raw, authentic, and fascinating working market where the day's freshest catch is auctioned and sold directly from the boats. Dozens of species of Mediterranean fish, shrimp, crabs, and shellfish displayed on ice. A unique sensory experience and cultural attraction in its own right. Not for the faint-hearted but unmissable for adventurous food lovers.
places.atmosphere: raw, authentic, aromatic, lively, local, maritime
places.ideal_for: food adventurers, photography, local culture, absolute freshness
places.best_time: very early morning (5–8am) when boats return

places.name: Magic Planet (City Centre Alexandria)
places.description: A large indoor family entertainment zone inside City Centre Mall featuring arcade games, rides, laser tag, bumper cars, and redemption games for kids and teenagers. Part of the Majid Al Futtaim entertainment group and one of the best indoor activity centers in Alexandria. Great for families with children or young groups who want fun and excitement.
places.activity_type: family with kids or teen groups
places.ideal_for: kids entertainment, arcade games, family fun, rainy days
places.location: City Centre Mall, Moharam Bek, Alexandria

places.name: Alexandria Cinemas (Cinema Cairo & San Stefano)
places.description: Alexandria has several good cinema experiences — the 10-screen multiplex at San Stefano Grand Plaza (including IMAX) and the 7-screen complex at City Centre are the best. Both show the latest Hollywood and local Egyptian films. San Stefano's cinema is particularly well-regarded for its comfortable seating, excellent sound, and modern facilities.
places.ideal_for: movie lovers, dates, entertainment, evening activity
places.location: San Stefano Mall and City Centre Mall, Alexandria

places.name: Action Zone Egypt (Paintball Arena)
places.description: Alexandria's top paintball arena, highly rated for its professionally designed arena layouts, quality equipment, strict safety measures, and energetic competitive atmosphere. Great for team-building, friend groups, or solo adventurers. Staff are professional and beginner-friendly. One of the most thrilling and memorable adrenaline-fueled activities available in Alexandria.
places.ideal_for: thrill-seekers, competitive people, groups, team activities

places.name: Bowling & Entertainment at Tivoli Dome
places.description: Tivoli Dome in Sidi Gaber houses one of Alexandria's best bowling alleys alongside arcade games, billiards, a climbing wall, and various entertainment options within its large complex. A complete entertainment hub for groups of all ages. Very popular on weeknights and weekends as one of Alexandria's main social activity hubs.
places.atmosphere: social, competitive, fun, lively, diverse entertainment
places.ideal_for: bowling fans, group activities, varied entertainment, social nights
places.location: Tivoli Dome Complex, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria

places.name: Boat Tour / Harbor Cruise
places.description: One of Alexandria's most unique and romantic experiences — a boat tour through the Eastern Harbour offering views of the submerged ruins of Cleopatra's palace, the Citadel of Qaitbay, the Bibliotheca Alexandrina from the sea, and the city skyline. Several operators run short tours especially at sunset. A completely different and memorable perspective on Alexandria.
places.atmosphere: scenic, peaceful, romantic, unique perspective, maritime
places.ideal_for: romantic outings, unique perspectives, history lovers, photography

places.name: El Alamein War Cemetery & Military Museum
places.description: A deeply moving war memorial about 106km west of Alexandria containing the graves of over 7,000 Allied soldiers who died in the 1940–1942 Western Desert Campaign of WWII. The adjacent El Alamein Military Museum tells the story of the pivotal Battle of El Alamein with tanks, aircraft, and war artifacts. A profound historical and emotional day trip from Alexandria.
places.atmosphere: solemn, reflective, historically significant, peaceful, moving
places.ideal_for: WWII history enthusiasts, reflective travelers, day trip from Alexandria

places.name: Cap d'Or Bar
places.description: A small, legendary bar in Downtown Alexandria dating back decades, blessed with a gorgeous original Art Nouveau interior. Serves Egyptian Stella beer, cognacs, and spirits. Walls covered in maritime memorabilia and old Alexandria nostalgia. Snacks arrive with drinks. A genuine, unpretentious local institution open until around 2am. Perfect for those who appreciate historic ambiance and authentic dives.
places.ideal_for: history lovers, beer lovers, authentic local experiences, night owls
places.location: Downtown Alexandria, off Saad Zaghloul Square

places.name: Sky View Lounge (Metropole Hotel)
places.description: A rooftop bar, restaurant, and lounge atop the historic Paradise Inn-Metropole Hotel offering panoramic Mediterranean sunset views. Comes alive nightly with live entertainment, dinner service, and cocktails. Features inviting outdoor couches with sea views. One of the most scenic evening spots in Alexandria. Can get windy — dress accordingly.
places.atmosphere: scenic, lively, social, romantic, panoramic views
places.ideal_for: sunset drinks, live entertainment, romantic evening, social nights

places.name: Monty Bar (Cecil Hotel)
places.description: A wood-paneled heritage bar inside the legendary Cecil Hotel named after General Montgomery who commanded Allied troops at El Alamein. One of Alexandria's most atmospheric drinking spots with a mix of expats, intellectuals, and sophisticated locals. Features regular live music in an intimate, conversation-friendly setting. A piece of living colonial-era Alexandrian history.
places.atmosphere: historic, sophisticated, intimate, wood-paneled, expat crowd
places.ideal_for: history lovers, intellectuals, sophisticated evenings, expat scene
places.location: Cecil Hotel, Saad Zaghloul Square, Alexandria

places.name: NEO Lounge & Bar (Hilton Corniche)
places.description: An upscale, opulent lounge and sports bar at the Hilton Alexandria Corniche hotel. Serves Mediterranean cuisine, exotic cocktails, wines, and spirits in a stylish atmosphere with live DJ music, jazz evenings, and entertainment. Popular with young professionals and visitors seeking a modern, high-energy upscale night out in Alexandria.
places.ideal_for: upscale nights out, cocktails, live music, young professionals
places.location: Hilton Alexandria Corniche Hotel, Corniche, Alexandria

places.name: Four Seasons Spa (San Stefano)
places.description: A world-class luxury spa at the Four Seasons Hotel San Stefano offering a full menu of massages, facials, body treatments, hydrotherapy, sauna, steam room, and Jacuzzi. Uses premium international products. A completely pampering and restorative experience for visitors seeking absolute relaxation and luxury wellness. The finest spa experience in all of Alexandria.
places.ideal_for: luxury seekers, wellness enthusiasts, stress relief, romantic retreat
places.location: Four Seasons Hotel, San Stefano, Alexandria

places.name: Shisha Café Culture (Corniche & Downtown)
places.description: Sitting at an open-air Corniche café with a shisha (hookah) and fresh juice while watching the Mediterranean is one of Alexandria's most authentic local experiences. Several traditional cafes opposite the Bibliotheca Alexandrina and along the Corniche offer this experience. A relaxed, unhurried, deeply social ritual that is central to Alexandrian daily life.
places.atmosphere: relaxed, social, authentic, breezy, local ritual
places.ideal_for: cultural immersion, relaxation, people-watching, authentic Alexandria
places.location: Various spots along the Corniche, Alexandria

places.name: Ras El-Tin Palace (Exterior & Harbor View)
places.description: One of Egypt's oldest and most historically significant palaces, originally the summer residence of Muhammad Ali Pasha. Now serves as a presidential residence and is not open to visitors — but the exterior, surrounding harbor views, and the atmosphere of the Anfushi neighborhood make it a worthwhile visit. An important symbol of Alexandria's royal and political history.
places.ideal_for: history enthusiasts, architectural appreciation, quiet walks
